ValidationRule.description: When Case = Sales Offers Request & Type = Campaign & Sub Type = FOC Qantas Club Waiver & Created Date >=25, Campaign Start Date > 2 Months
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND ( RecordTypeId = "01290000001UPUR", /*Sales Offers Request*/ NOT ( $UserRole.Id = $Label.QF_Support_QIC_Member), /*QF-Support-Agency Support-QAC*/ ISPICKVAL ( Type , "Campaign" ), ISPICKVAL ( Sub_Type__c , "FOC Qantas Club Waiver"),
DAY( DATEVALUE( CreatedDate ) ) >= 25, NOT ( MONTH ( Campaign_Start_Date__c ) > MONTH ( DATEVALUE( CreatedDate ))+ 1) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For any Case created > 25th, the Campaign Start Date has to be greater than the next 2 months - FOC Qantas Club Waiver
